employees.evidence: as long as we feel good about their managers and labor relations.

shareholders.evidence: We want to make money only when our partners do and in exactly the same proportion.

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: Written mainly in first-person plural and singular by the Chairman, addressing owner-partners first. Tone is factual and candid rather than aspirational, with many absolute pledges (we will never, we will not) alongside hedged hopes (we hope, we try). Shareholder alignment and candor in reporting dominate; workforce, community and environment are essentially absent. Distinctive wording: owner-partners, eat our own cooking, gin rummy behavior.
